propositions: Coverage instrumentation is applied identically across three Ubuntu Python cells (3.11, 3.12, 3.13) despite no sys.version branches in production code, causing duplicate measurement overhead without distinct verdict.
Benchmark experiment (A-B-B-A-A-B) measured 34 seconds wall-clock median delta per instrumented cell, confirming coverage tracing cost is separable from test execution cost.
OSS consensus check (Django, NumPy, SciPy) shows three major projects selectively collect coverage on single primary cells while broader compatibility jobs run uninstrumented, establishing precedent.

The change must relocate coverage collection and fail-under enforcement to Ubuntu Python 3.13 alone while retaining all four matrix cells, both default and integration pytest tiers, and the unchanged branch=true and fail_under=70 thresholds.

Workflow contract test must enforce that only Ubuntu 3.13 receives coverage flags (non-empty truthy branch), all other cells receive empty string (final or-slot), and defect seeds for prior all-Ubuntu condition and zero-coverage condition must independently fail the contract.
